senses.gloss:
OUGHT, v. irreg. (Be bound, be obliged, be necessary) ex-
pressed by the fut. pass. part.; as, ‘you ought to marry
the damsel,’ त्वया कन्या वोढव्या; ‘we ought to restrain an-
ger,’ अस्माभिः कोपः नियन्तव्यः; ‘I ought not to do that,’ मया
तत् न कर्त्तव्यं or करणीयं or कार्य्यं, or sometimes by the po-
tential mood; as, ‘he ought to treat his son like a friend,’
पुत्रं मित्रवद् आचरेत्, or by the use of the verb अर्ह्; as, ‘he
ought to give,’ दातुम् अर्हति; ‘to act as one ought,’ यथो-
चितं or यथायोग्यं or यथार्हं कृ.
